full_judgment: 3. Mr. Asrarul Hossain, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner has taken us through the application and the relevant rules and submits that Rule 14(5) of the Navy Rules has no application to the case of the petitioner and his service could only be taken away in the public interest. And at least the petitioner was entitled to a notice to show cause or an opportunity of being heard. He has cited on that point the decision in the case of A. Saboor Khan Vs. Karachi University reported in 18 DLR (SC) , 422 wherein it was observed that "a duty is cast on every Administrative Tribunal to act with due regard to the principles of natural justice, unless specifically exempted from such a limitation. Mere omission from the relevant law of a provision for notice, would not affect this position. It was further, held in that case that" no one can be condemned unheard is one of the Settled principles of law, and such a principle will be read into the relevant law, unless its application is excluded by express words"
